title: Add narrow stale systemd cleanup privilege
goal: Provide a narrow fail-closed privileged path, or explicit manual runbook, for clearing stale failed systemd unit state such as user@111.service without broad sudo.

acceptance.assertion: The privileged path cannot restart, stop, enable, disable or edit arbitrary services.
It can only clear failed state for an explicitly allowed target or class after read-only status checks.
The Heim-PC audit can clear stale user@111.service without granting general sudo, or the runbook records the exact manual command.

metadata.live_audit_finding: system systemd remained degraded because user@111.service stale fail could not be reset without sudo; broker had no reset-failed action.
metadata.block_reason: The historical dependency on T030 is no longer current: the root-owned privileged broker, configuration and socket are valid and ready. The task remains blocked because the canonical recovery evidence for heimberry:rest-server/grabowski-recovery-probe is stale and AUDIO-CONTROL-PLANE-V1-T031 actively holds host:heim-pc. No reset-failed effect is authorized until both conditions clear and the exact unit properties are freshly revalidated.
metadata.next_action: After T031 reaches an authoritative terminal state and releases host:heim-pc, produce fresh server-recovery evidence for heimberry:rest-server/grabowski-recovery-probe. Then re-read the exact unit properties and execute only systemctl reset-failed for the unchanged allowlist; prove systemctl --failed is empty.

required_to_unblock: Authoritative terminal readback and controlled release of the T031 host lease.
Fresh recovery probe for the configured heimberry target.
Fresh unit-property readback proving the allowlist remains terminal and unchanged.

permission to run privileged reset-failed while recovery evidence is stale
that the historical unit candidates remain unchanged
